data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: As a friend would you say that if someone don't like me you will also hate them ASSISTANT:
No, I would not. Just because someone does not like me does not mean that I have to hate them. We can disagree and have our differences, but that does not mean that we have to be enemies.
